title: Nylas calendar.deleted notification object
description: Sent when a user deletes a calendar. This schema describes `data.object` inside the Nylas notification envelope.

grant_id.description: Unique identifier for the grant that owned this calendar.

id.description: Unique identifier for the deleted calendar.

is_primary.description: Whether this was the user's primary calendar.

name.description: Display name of the deleted calendar.

read_only.description: Whether the calendar was read-only for the authenticated user.

is_owned_by_user.description: Whether the authenticated user owned this calendar.

owner_email.description: Email address of the account that owned the calendar. Microsoft grants only; omitted for other providers.

hex_color.description: Background color of the calendar in hex format. May be omitted if not set by the provider.

hex_foreground_color.description: Foreground (text) color of the calendar in hex format. May be omitted if not set by the provider.
